description: fedramp_20x_vdr CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, tap#365) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that fedramp_20x_vdr is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (compliance_core, pinned at its released tag v0.8.7, and computing_core, pinned at v0.10.2) plus fedramp_20x_vdr itself, pinned at its release tag (the placeholder v0.0.0 until the first release, which release-please then advances); the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds fedramp_20x_vdr (seed-only, offline). DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/fedramp-20x-vdr-tap@<release tag>#ci' --dev-plugins fedramp_20x_vdr

steps.note: Own GRIFT: seeding it proves the 53 timeframe rows import and satisfy the model schemas against a real registry.
